title: How long have you (been) ... ?
subtitle: Как давно? Настоящее против present perfect; haven't … since/for

theory.text: Если ситуация началась в прошлом и продолжается сейчас, а мы говорим, как долго она длится, нужен present perfect. По-русски в таких фразах настоящее время: «они женаты 15 лет», «я знаю его со школы».

head: Сейчас (present)
Как долго (present perfect)
rows: Kate has been in hospital since Friday.
How long have they had this dog?

items: С «как долго» обычно выбирают continuous: I've been learning Spanish since September.
Глаголы состояния — только simple: How long have you known Mike? I've had a headache since this morning.
live и work — можно и так и так: has been living / has lived.
С always — только simple: I've always lived in Moscow.

theory.text: «Я не видел его с…», «она не звонила уже…» — present perfect simple: I haven't seen Ben since last week. Emma hasn't called for weeks.

Не переводите дословно: «Как давно вы женаты?» — это не How long are you married?, а How long have you been married? И «Они женаты 15 лет» — не They are married for 15 years, а They've been married for 15 years.

items.ru: Они женаты пятнадцать лет.
en: They've been married for fifteen years.
They've been married for 15 years.
They've been married fifteen years.

items.ru: Как давно вы женаты?
en: How long have you been married?

items.ru: Кейт в больнице с пятницы.
en: Kate has been in hospital since Friday.
Kate has been in the hospital since Friday.

items.ru: Мы знаем друг друга со школы.
en: We've known each other since school.
We've known each other since we were at school.

items.ru: Как давно ты знаешь Майка?
en: How long have you known Mike?

items.ru: Как давно у них эта собака?
en: How long have they had this dog?
How long have they had that dog?
How long have they had their dog?

items.ru: Мы ждём совсем недолго.
en: We haven't been waiting long.
We haven't been waiting very long.
We haven't been waiting for long.

items.ru: Я учу испанский с сентября.
en: I've been learning Spanish since September.
I've been studying Spanish since September.

items.ru: Снег идёт всё утро.
en: It's been snowing all morning.

items.ru: Джек делает эту работу двадцать лет.
en: Jack has been doing this job for twenty years.
Jack has been doing this job for 20 years.
Jack has done this job for twenty years.

items.ru: Как давно Анна водит машину?
en: How long has Anna been driving?

items.ru: Как давно твой брат работает в этом банке?
en: How long has your brother been working at this bank?
How long has your brother been working in this bank?
How long has your brother worked at this bank?
How long has your brother worked in this bank?

items.ru: Лиза живёт в Риме с 2018 года.
en: Lisa has been living in Rome since 2018.
Lisa has lived in Rome since 2018.

items.ru: Я всегда жил в Москве.
en: I've always lived in Moscow.

items.ru: Он всегда хотел поехать в Японию.
en: He's always wanted to go to Japan.
He's always wanted to visit Japan.

items.ru: Я не видел Бена с прошлой недели.
en: I haven't seen Ben since last week.

items.ru: Эмма не звонит уже несколько недель.
en: Emma hasn't called for weeks.
Emma hasn't called for several weeks.
Emma hasn't phoned for weeks.
Emma hasn't called for a few weeks.

items.ru: Мы целую вечность не были в театре.
en: We haven't been to the theatre for ages.
We haven't been to the theater for ages.
We haven't been to the theatre in ages.

items.ru: Я не играю в футбол уже много лет.
en: I haven't played football for years.
I haven't played football for many years.
I haven't played football in years.

items.ru: Как давно ты в Лондоне?
en: How long have you been in London?

items.ru: С тех пор как мы приехали, погода ужасная.
en: The weather has been awful since we arrived.
The weather has been terrible since we arrived.
Since we arrived, the weather has been awful.
Since we arrived, the weather has been terrible.

items.ru: Сара замужем за итальянцем.
en: Sarah is married to an Italian.
Sarah is married to an Italian man.

items.ru: Я очень хорошо его знаю.
en: I know him very well.

items.ru: У меня болит голова с самого утра.
en: I've had a headache since this morning.
I've had a headache since the morning.
I've had a headache all morning.
